parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the long-term memory belongs. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 长期记忆体所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.example: 我的大模型应用$APP_ID关于A用户的长期记忆体
parameters.help_en: The description of the long-term memory. The description must be 1 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and characters in the Unicode letter category (including Chinese characters). The description can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 长期记忆体的描述信息。长度为 1~50 个字符，支持 Unicode 中 letter 分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

memoryId.description_en:
The long-term memory ID.
Store this value properly. It is required for all subsequent API operations related to this long-term memory.
memoryId.description_zh:
长期记忆体 ID。
请妥善保管该值，它将用于后续所有与此长期记忆体相关的API操作
